hero.heading: An education built on the Word of God.

anniversary.heading: Twenty years of Westside Baptist Academy.
anniversary.body:
This school year is the Academy's twentieth. Two decades of families who chose to have their children taught, corrected and prayed for by people who share their convictions — and of graduates who left here able to think clearly and give a reason for what they believe.

We are grateful, and we are still enrolling.

doors.heading: New Families
doors.text: Learn what an education here looks like, what it costs, and how to apply. We enroll year-round as space allows.

doors.heading: Current Families
doors.text: Homework schedules, the school calendar, forms, supply lists and everything else you need during the week.

doors.heading: What We Believe
doors.text: We are a ministry of Westside Baptist Church, and our convictions shape every classroom on this campus.

why.heading: A small school that knows your child by name.
why.lede: Westside Baptist Academy opened in 2007 as a ministry of Westside Baptist Church. What has not changed since is the reason we exist: to come alongside Christian parents rather than replace them.

marks.heading: Christ-centered instruction
marks.text: Scripture is not a subject added to the schedule. It is the framework every subject is taught inside of.

marks.heading: Low student-to-teacher ratios
marks.text: Teachers know each student's strengths, gaps and character — and so do their parents.

marks.heading: Rigorous academics
marks.text: A college-preparatory curriculum that graduates students ready for what comes next.

marks.heading: Strong standardized testing
marks.text: Annual achievement testing keeps our academics honest and measurable.

marks.heading: Consistent character training
marks.text: Expectations are clear, applied evenly, and reinforced by the same adults every day.

marks.heading: Chapel each week
marks.text: Corporate worship and preaching are a normal part of the school week.

marks.heading: A full fine arts program
marks.text: Choir, orchestra, ensembles and art — taught, not treated as an afterthought.

marks.heading: Qualified, ministry-minded faculty
marks.text: Our teachers are here because they believe in the work, not because it was the job available.

goals.heading: Our program is designed so that students will…
items: Think, be independent, work and read.
Nurture in and act upon Scriptural principles.
Treat one another with love, loyalty, honesty, and wisdom.
Share the Gospel in the community and show Christlikeness.

ministry.eyebrow: A ministry of Westside Baptist Church
ministry.heading: The school and the church are not separate things.
ministry.text: The Academy meets on the church campus, under the authority of the same pastor and the same doctrinal position. Families are not required to be members, but they should know clearly what we teach and why.

callToAction.heading: Enrolling now for K5 through 12th grade
callToAction.text: Call the office, or schedule a tour and see the school on an ordinary day — that is when you learn the most.
